item.title: Class of 2026 Announced
item.description: The Texas Sports Hall of Fame has announced its Class of 2026, honoring nine legendary individuals and teams whose achievements have shaped sports history in Texas, the nation, and the world. The inductees will be celebrated during the 65th Annual Texas Sports Hall of Fame Induction Banquet, presented by Texas Farm Bureau Insurance, on Saturday, April 18, 2026, at the BASE at Extraco Events Center in Waco.

item.title: Robert C. Mcnair

item.description: A native of San Antonio, Texas, Rudy Davalos distinguished himself as an accomplished basketball student-athlete at Southwest Texas State University.
